description: Extend the Beat Planner from single-agent to multi-agent. A supervisor enters 2-5 agent names at upload, assigns each beat to an agent via a GCU-grouped table, schedules each agent's beats across the week, and exports per-agent per-day KML/CSV files.

userStories.title: Update TypeScript types for multi-agent support
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the shared types to support multiple agents so that all downstream components and API routes can be built on a consistent data model.
acceptanceCriteria: types/index.ts: add `agents: string[]` — replaces `agentName: string` in dashboard state shape
types/index.ts: add `assignedAgent?: string` field to BeatResult interface
types/index.ts: document that dayAssignments shape is `{ [agentName: string]: { [beatId: number]: string } }` (comment or type alias)
No runtime behaviour changes — types only
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Dynamic agent entry in UploadForm
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want to enter multiple agent names when uploading a CSV so that I can plan my full team's week in one session.
acceptanceCriteria: UploadForm renders a dynamic list of agent name inputs (one shown by default)
'+ Add Agent' button appends a new empty text input, up to a maximum of 5
Each agent name input has a remove button (hidden when only one field remains)
Upload button is disabled until every agent name field is non-empty and the CSV file is selected
On successful upload, the component passes `agents: string[]` (array of entered names) to the parent dashboard via the existing onUpload callback
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: AgentBeatAssignment component
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want to assign each beat to an agent via a GCU-grouped table so that I can quickly allocate an entire GCU's beats to one person.
acceptanceCriteria: New component `components/AgentBeatAssignment.tsx` is created
Accepts props: `beats: BeatResult[]`, `agents: string[]`, `onAssignmentChange: (beatId: number, agentName: string) => void`
Renders beats grouped under GCU header rows (sorted alphabetically by GCU name)
Each beat row shows: Beat ID, store count, and a dropdown whose options are the `agents` array (plus an empty default option '-- Assign agent --')
A progress indicator at the top displays 'X of Y beats assigned'
A 'Continue' button is disabled while any beat is unassigned; enabled when all beats have an agent selected
Selecting a dropdown fires `onAssignmentChange(beatId, agentName)` immediately
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Wire AgentBeatAssignment into dashboard
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want the beat assignment step to appear automatically after clustering so that the workflow guides me to assign agents before scheduling days.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard state: `agentName: string` replaced by `agents: string[]` (received from UploadForm)
Dashboard state: `beatAssignments: Record<number, string>` tracks which agent each beat is assigned to
After clustering completes, dashboard renders `AgentBeatAssignment` instead of the day-assignment table
When the user clicks 'Continue' in AgentBeatAssignment, dashboard advances to the day-assignment step and stores beat assignments in state
Each beat's `assignedAgent` is set in the beats array before passing it downstream
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: AgentDaySchedule component with tabs
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want to schedule each agent's beats on separate tabs so that each agent's weekly plan is independent and easy to manage.
acceptanceCriteria: New component `components/AgentDaySchedule.tsx` is created
Accepts props: `agents: string[]`, `beats: BeatResult[]`, `dayAssignments: Record<string, Record<number, string>>`, `onDayChange: (agentName: string, beatId: number, day: string) => void`
Renders one tab button per agent across the top
Active tab shows only the beats assigned to that agent (filtered by `beat.assignedAgent`)
Each beat row has the existing Mon–Sat day selector
Changing a day selector fires `onDayChange(agentName, beatId, day)`
Dashboard replaces the existing flat day-assignment table with `AgentDaySchedule`, passing `dayAssignments` as `{ [agentName]: { [beatId]: day } }`
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Per-agent exports
userStories.description: As a supervisor, I want to download KML and CSV files per agent per day so that each agent can open their own daily route in Google Maps.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard export section renders one block per agent (agent name as heading)
Each agent block shows download buttons only for days that agent has at least one beat assigned
Each download button is labelled with the day (e.g. 'Monday KML', 'Monday CSV')
POST /api/kml and POST /api/csv accept `agentName: string` in the request body and filter beats to only that agent's assigned beats for the given day
KML filename is `[agentName]-[day].kml`; CSV filename is `[agentName]-[day].csv`
Existing KML/CSV structure and field content is unchanged — only filtered scope
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
